d.title: Meitantei Conan OVA 10: Kid in Trap Island
d.en: Detective Conan OVA 10: Kid in Trap Island
d.jp: 名探偵コナン ～KID in TRAP ISLAND～
d.synopsis: In this entirely new story produced specifically for the DVD, Conan leads a group of young detectives against the phantom thief Kaitou Kid, who has his eyes set on a jewel at a hotel on an isolated island.
